material.description: blocked_by: gap-late-join-snapshot-witness. Approved scope makes /state units an array; ci.yml lines 904,1671,1679,1726,2238,2239,2456,2465 read .units as a count (jq -r .units, test -gt, arithmetic). Decision needed: keep numeric count under another key with the array under units, or permit editing those 8 jq expressions (scope currently says one appended job). Also U2: delta has no alive flag, so dead-unit removal needs room.rs to emit {id, alive:false}. Receipt: .gm/receipts/gap-late-join-snapshot-witness/01-orient.md
